edges.notes: plate base follows the upper skin (same vertices as the core)
four thin foam-tape pads on the plate (FC on the wing centre, not on the cage hub: SITL-FLIGHT follow-up 2; hard mount, BOARD D-186)
FC on the tape pads, M2 screws (hard mount; gel only if its frequency is measured at 40-70 Hz)
pitot in a groove in the LE at y = +0.41 (outside the rotor wash, EST)
cover stands on the plate (and its front ramp on the skin ahead of the plate), foam tape + two ties; removable for FC access (D-198)
four M2 screws through the stack standoffs (hardware of E-AVN-03)

joint_stack.access: from the aft side before the arm is bonded

edges.notes: screw threads into the nut (stock M2 x 25: tip 0.1 mm short of to 0.6 mm past the nut bottom)

joint_stack.fastener: M2 x 25 pan screw into M2 thin nut
joint_stack.access: from the aft side before the arm is bonded

edges.notes: four M2 thin nuts trapped in hex pockets on the plate underside (seated before the plate goes on the skin)

joint_stack.fastener: M2 pan screw + M2 thin nut (DIN 439, 1.2 mm)
joint_stack.hole: 2.2 mm hole + hex pocket in the plate (plate 1.5-2.1 mm)
joint_stack.access: from the aft side before the arm is bonded
